title: Review of Casa Verde Restaurant ★★★★☆
L: I took my parents to Casa Verde for my father's birthday last Saturday.
The food was excellent, especially the grilled fish, and the portions were generous.
The staff even brought a small cake with a candle without us asking, which my father loved.
The only disappointment was the wait: although we had a reservation for 7:00, we were not seated until almost 7:40.
The manager apologized and offered us free coffee, which was a nice gesture.
I would definitely return, but I would book an earlier table. — Paula Grant
